`AgoraRTC_N-4.22.0.js` is the unmodified `AgoraRTC_N-production.js` from the npm package
`agora-rtc-sdk-ng@4.22.0` (MIT licence, © Agora Inc.). It is served locally so voice calls
don't depend on a CDN being reachable (venue Wi-Fi, strict networks).
`qrcode-1.4.4.js` is `qrcode.js` from the npm package `qrcode-generator@1.4.4` (MIT licence, Kazuhiko Arase), used to draw the join-call QR code.
